newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Maastricht air cargo up 24 pct in Jan-Sept 1996.
newsitem.headline: Maastricht air cargo up 24 pct in Jan-Sept 1996.

text.p: Airfreight traffic at Maastricht-Aachen rose 24 percent in the in the first nine months of 1996, the airport operating company said in a statement.
It added the airport handled a total of 30,915 tonnes of freight, with approximately 21,000 tonnes moved on scheduled freight services, and 9,900 tonnes carried by chartered freight flights.

A further 3,700 tonnes of trucked airfreight was handled by the airport, significantly down -- by 70 percent -- on this time last year, reflecting British Airways World Cargo's decision last year to shut down its European trucking operation which had been based at Maastricht.
Maastricht said a total of 291,000 passengers used the airport in the first three quarters of 1996, up 11 percent on last year.
